name: lenovo.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain read and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 67 of 67 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.lenovo.com scores 67 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: plain http…

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /be/nl/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /be/nl/, for example .lang_entry_container. Impact: critical.

fix.title: 3 resources fail to load
fix.fix: Fix or remove the broken references.

fix.title: 18 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: ak_bmsc, bm_sz. Set on /be/nl/.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 0.8 s
Every page has a meta description
Language alternates point at each other
